Everything here is derivable from the repository — nothing depends on a conversation being remembered. Read it, run the subject guard, continue at next_admissible_unit.

completed_units.evidence: Two runs compared. Denied run: attempt 1 plans one step, policy_blocked (budget 2, requires_different_action), continue, attempt 2's plan comes back empty from the forbidden filter, break on the SUCCESS branch. Control run: planner returns no sources at all. Their non-journal observation dictionaries are literally equal — failure_context_reached_synthesis False, obligation_count 0, answer_mentions_a_block False, replan_exhausted False. completed_units.the_sharp_part: The obligation arbiter exists to catch a silently missing observation. It receives the denial — loop_run_tail.py:301 reads policy_blocked out of a non-empty failure_history into denied_tools — and builds its obligations from plan_steps, which is the LAST attempt's empty plan. The mechanism that emptied the plan removed the obligation the denial would have marked.
completed_units.made_durable: tests/test_empty_plan_provenance.py. The MECHANISM is asserted plainly (step stopped, retry empty, no artifact invented). The COLLAPSE is xfail(strict=True) on a claim that prescribes no design — a denied run should differ from a no-tool run somewhere outside the journal. Verified with --runxfail that it fails on the assertion, not on an error. Any repair XPASSes and strict turns that into a failure.

evaluation_domain_audit_E2.question: Can the held values of every unit lacking a structured evaluation_domain be recovered from durable artifacts without re-running the experiment?
evaluation_domain_audit_E2.result: YES for all ten. Four are RUNTIME_DOMAIN_FREE (static analysis has no runtime domain), three are NOT_APPLICABLE (no measurement), three are DOMAIN_RECONSTRUCTED from probe scripts, test files and commit messages that all still exist. DOMAIN_IRRECOVERABLE: none.
evaluation_domain_audit_E2.hypothesis_corrected: The previous review asserted 'zero reruns required' as a conclusion. It was a hypothesis. This audit establishes it; before the audit it was not evidence.
evaluation_domain_audit_E2.term_corrected: RUNTIME_DOMAIN_FREE, not DOMAIN_FREE. A static unit still depends on the snapshot, on the tool version and on its discovery rule — it is free of a RUNTIME domain, not of all conditions.
evaluation_domain_audit_E2.rule_going_forward: Ambient conditions are declared once in ambient_evaluation_domain. A unit records only the values it HELD that could have been otherwise and that its conclusion depends on. Quotienting or equivalence claims across units with incompatible held values are forbidden — this is the rule that C08-U1 (max_replan_attempts=1) and C08-U2 (=3) needed and did not have.
